SourceProvenance.OfficialResourceRecord: AO_CLIENT_EP1_RDB_BASE member containing PF4582 PlayfieldDistrictInfo records
SourceProvenance.Conclusion: The supplied JSON is a derived official-resource extract with field-level limits: both official EP1 and EP2 PF4582 resource windows reproduce the exact 206-value TemplateHash multiset and all 38 multiplicities, and the official parser exposes the matching hash-spawn placement structure. Variable serialized sections prevent claiming a flat fixed-record table. The exact exporter, its version, the JSON field labels, source names, and NpcId lineage remain unavailable.

OfficialSemantics.TemplateFieldStructureOffset: HashSpawnPoint_t+0x24 in inspected EP2 runtime build
OfficialSemantics.Conclusion: The official resource stores the exact JSON numeric value as a big-endian uint32 byte pattern, and GameData parses the corresponding spawn value into a one-uint32 ACGHash_t. The exposed official API calls it a hash, parser text calls it a template, and GetHashAsText can render it as text; neither official build exposes a field named TemplateHash. No inspected consumer joins the value to a stable mob template, MonsterData, or live identity. All 206 supplied NpcIds are absent from both bounded PF4582 resource windows and no NpcId field exists in the inspected HashSpawnPoint layout.
